scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: No elevation or other floor is supplied: floor z=0 and ceiling height 3.0 m are explicit assumptions for the whole floor.
All door leaf heights assumed 2.1 m; all window sill/head assumed 0.9/2.7 m - no height evidence exists in the input.
Exterior wall thickness 240 mm read from double-line spacing (11 px); interior partitions drawn as ~5-6 px line pairs, nominal ~120 mm assumed.
Door operating states unknown; swing arcs give hinge side only.
Room roles (office/meeting/corridor) inferred from furniture; no text labels relied upon.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: P_corr_north_w declared on its measured north face line y957 (faces 957/969) so it closes at the strip ring corner; the corridor polygon therefore includes that 12px wall band on its north side.

The original shows no ink at x698-790 on this wall where the vertical corridor continues south into the bottom-wing corridor; the corridor is one continuous open space, so no aperture object was invented. Check in wall-support review.
Cyan window band W_N1 drawn as one continuous ~8 m glazed band; any mullions within it were not resolved.
Interior partition faces measured from single line pairs; exact thicknesses below drawing line width are uncertain.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

plan_compilation.basis: Calibration from overall dimension annotations 25000x20000 mm mapped to observed outer wall faces: x px282->1437 = 0->25.0 m, y px1235->310 = 0->20.0 m (scales 21.65 and 21.62 mm/px agree within 0.15%). Dimension baselines are the outer faces of exterior walls (240 mm = 11 px, verified on all four sides); interior partitions are measured line-pair centrelines (~5-6 px ~= 110-130 mm). Windows measured as cyan ink extents, doors as cyan jamb marks; grey wall ink rgb~150 tol 80, cyan rgb(11,164,144) tol 90.

limits: Two caller-supplied anchors per axis define the transform but do not independently close a dimension chain.
The overlay does not inspect original pixels or automatically decide positional error.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.
